updated_claim: Indonesia and Malaysia combined produce approximately 14–19 million tonnes of palm kernel shell (PKS) per year (central estimate 15–18 Mt), derived from: Indonesia CPO ~50 Mt (GAPKI 2024) + Malaysia CPO ~18.6 Mt (MPOB 2023), back-calculated to FFB via official OERs, then multiplied by the GAPKI-stated PKS yield of 5–6% of FFB. The original claim of '>18 Mt/yr' sits at the top of this range and is achievable only at a 6% PKS/FFB yield; a more conservative midpoint (5.5%) gives ~17 Mt combined. Revised claim: 'Indonesia and Malaysia combined generate an estimated 15–19 Mt of PKS per year, with a central estimate of approximately 16–17 Mt at a 5–5.5% PKS/FFB yield ratio.'

sources_found.key_quote: The production of crude palm oil (CPO) in 2023 was projected to reach 50.07 million tons or an increase of 7.15% compared to that of 2022 at 46.73 million tons. Palm kernel oil (PKO) reached 4.77 million tons.

sources_found.publication: Malaysian Palm Oil Board (MPOB) — Overview of Malaysian Oil Palm Industry 2023
sources_found.key_quote: Crude palm oil production reached 18.55 million tonnes in 2023. Oil extraction rate (OER) increased 0.8% to 19.86%.

sources_found.publication: GAPKI — citing APCASI (Indonesian Palm Shell Industry Association)
sources_found.key_quote: In 2019, PKS production reached 9.97 million tons, of which 1.72 million tons were exported (17.25% of total production). Every palm oil mill produces 50–70 kg of palm shells per tonne of FFB.
PKS is around 5–6 percent of FFB. Biomass from fruit fiber and shells totals approximately 29.52 million tons per year [Indonesia]; fronds and leaves at 114.39 million tons per year.

sources_found.publication: BPS-Statistics Indonesia — Indonesian Oil Palm Statistics 2023
sources_found.key_quote: Annual publication presenting data of area and production on oil palm by province and by category of producers. Indonesia CPO 2023: 50.07 Mt (GAPKI-consistent).

methodology_note: Bottom-up calculation: Indonesia FFB 2023 ≈ 218–228 Mt (CPO 50.07 Mt ÷ 22–23% OER). Malaysia FFB 2023 ≈ 93.4 Mt (CPO 18.55 Mt ÷ 19.86% MPOB OER). PKS at 5%: combined ~15.6–16.0 Mt. PKS at 5.5%: combined ~17.1–17.7 Mt. PKS at 6%: combined ~18.7–19.3 Mt. Cross-check: APCASI direct figure for Indonesia 2019 = 9.97 Mt implies a ~4.6% ratio, yielding ~14–15 Mt combined at 2023 CPO levels. The '>18 Mt' claim requires the high end (6%) of the yield range.
confidence_reasoning: Strong primary sources for CPO production (GAPKI, MPOB). The 5-6% PKS/FFB ratio is well-established in engineering literature and confirmed by GAPKI. The 18 Mt threshold is at the top of the plausible range; a revised range of 14–19 Mt (central ~16–17 Mt) is better supported. Recommend revising the claim from '>18 Mt' to '15–19 Mt' with midpoint disclosure.
